name: Slave Police Michiru & Misuzu
original_name: スレイブポリスみちる＆美鈴
source:
On the surface, Date Ryouhei is a capable young officer, but he has a secret life where he imprisons and trains women to become sex slaves on orders from his superiors.

His latest assignment is to train two well-known beautiful female officers who work as part of a "crime prevention campaign team".

Date is hesitant, but his superiors offer him a secret plan, a new type of drug that has a powerful suggestive effect and also an aphrodisiac effect...

[Edited from the [url=http://www.bishop.gr.jp/products/spmm/index.html]official site[/url]]
